Tara M.: FYI running into SDK vs REST parity during onboarding. Bulk embeddings are a blocker: REST accepts inputs array + metadata, our SDKs keep sending `input` and sometimes stringify arrays.

Ibrahim K.: Which language/version? Any traces?

Tara M.: Node SDK v0.9.3 in the sample-app. Minimal repro: REST works fine: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/bulk -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"open-embedding-1","inputs":[{"text":"a","meta":{"row":1}},{"text":"b","meta":{"row":2}}]}' | jq
```

Tara M.: Using SDK we got 400 invalid_request. Network capture: SDK called /v1/embeddings with body `{"input":"[object Object]"}` and lost the meta object. Also saw retries: hosted returned 429 + Retry-After: 4, SDK retried twice immediately. That caused duplicate ingestion and double billing for that upload.

Rafael D.: Oof. Two issues: (A) request shape mismatch (should call /v1/embeddings/bulk with inputs array and preserve nested metadata), (B) retry policy ignores Retry-After header and silently retries. Both break onboarding flows that upload CSV/JSON batches.

Tara M.: Sample-app fix: switched to direct REST call for the loader. Patch in PR pending but want SDK fix.

Ibrahim K.: Quick plan: 1) add explicit `embeddings.bulk(inputs)` helper across SDKs (js/py/go) that POSTs to /v1/embeddings/bulk; 2) fix serializer to not coerce arrays/objects to strings; accept structured items `{text, id?, meta?}`; 3) make retry middleware honor Retry-After and expose a `retryHook`/callback so apps can cancel retries. 4) add integration e2e that posts 3 structured items and asserts server receives array intact.

QA Bot: integration/test_embeddings_bulk structured_items -> FAILED (400) at 1800500068

Rafael D.: Also add a short migration note: adding bulk method is non-breaking, but retry behavior will change (now honoring Retry-After). Document in SDK changelog so infra teams know.

Tara M.: I'll open the GH issue with traces and the failing CI job. Marking `priority: blocker` for sample-app onboarding.

Ibrahim K.: I'll pick up the JS PR and coordinate parity across languages. Rafael, can you own the retry middleware change? We should run the e2e against staging API and the hosted sandbox.

Rafael D.: On it. I'll add a config flag defaulting to honoring Retry-After but allow override for advanced users. Will include tests for header parsing and backoff scheduling.

Tara M.: Thanks team. For now sample-app docs updated to show the REST workaround and a note about potential duplicate uploads until SDKs ship. :thumbsup:

Docsy: Added onboarding note: "If you hit 400 on bulk uploads, use REST bulk endpoint as workaround" to docs/quickstart 1800500200

QA Bot: created issue redwood/sdk#1247 (sdk-parity, regression) linked to this thread at 1800500289

Tara M.: Thanks all. Will follow the PRs and revert sample-app to SDK calls once released.
